title: New course: AI for Peace Negotiators
content:
Take a look at the new hands-on course from School of Data, designed for peacebuilders and conflict analysts. The course focuses on understand the potential and limitations to the use of AI in politically and culturally delicate process aiming for peace.

The post New course: AI for Peace Negotiators first appeared on Open Knowledge Blog.
